headline.description: One line, under 100 characters, naming the failing component and the symptom. This becomes the GitHub issue title, so it must be readable on its own with no context.

diagnosis.description: Markdown. What the evidence shows, quoting the specific log lines or container states it rests on. Do not speculate beyond the evidence provided; say what is missing instead.

confidence.description: low means the captured evidence does not identify a cause. That is a legitimate and useful answer — a confident-sounding guess costs more than an honest 'the logs do not say'.

suspectedCause.description: Coarse category, so a run of these can be counted over time without reading each one. 'deploy-script' is included because a change to restart-prod.sh is a real and self-obscuring cause of deploy failure.

failingServices.description: Compose service names the evidence shows as unhealthy, exited or created. Empty when the failure was a hostname check rather than a container.

suspectCommits.description: Commits from the supplied range that plausibly caused this, most likely first. Empty is correct when the range gives no signal.

suggestedNextStep.description: One concrete action for the operator, phrased as a command or a check. Must not assume the site is up — it may be showing the maintenance page — and must not propose anything that needs a credential the operator has not been given.
